title: CECAR: Cache & Expert Co-Aware Routing Accelerates On-Device Inference of MoE LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2611.20119v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Despite growing interest in on-device LLM deployment, large-scale Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models remain impractical on resource-constrained devices, as sparse expert activation still requires all expert weights to be memory-resident. To address this, we identify three key observations for on-device MoE inference: (a) cache hit rates are fundamentally bounded even under Belady's optimal policy; (b) these bounds are insufficient for low-latency on-device inference; and (c) prior cache-aware routing based on binary cache presence can induce routing instability. Based on these insights, we propose CECAR (Cache & Expert Co-Aware Routing), a MoE inference system that jointly considers expert routing and cache management. Unlike prior cache-aware routing methods, CECAR uses an ML-based cache policy to predict the expected reuse distance of each expert and prioritizes routing and execution toward experts with smaller predicted reuse distances

translated_title: CECAR：缓存与专家协同感知路由加速MoE大语言模型的端侧推理
translated_abstract: 尽管端侧LLM部署日益受到关注，但大规模混合专家（MoE）模型在资源受限的设备上仍然不实用，因为稀疏的专家激活仍要求所有专家权重驻留在内存中。为解决这一问题，我们识别出端侧MoE推理的三个关键观察：(a) 即使在Belady最优策略下，缓存命中率也存在根本性上限；(b) 这些上限不足以支撑低延迟的端侧推理；(c) 先前基于二值缓存存在性的缓存感知路由可能引发路由不稳定。基于这些洞察，我们提出了CECAR（缓存与专家协同感知路由），这是一个联合考虑专家路由与缓存管理的MoE推理系统。与先前的缓存感知路由方法不同，CECAR使用基于机器学习的缓存策略来预测每个专家的预期重用距离，并将路由和执行优先指向预测重用距离较小的专家。
tldr: CECAR提出缓存与专家协同感知的路由系统，通过机器学习预测专家重用距离并优先路由重用距离较小的专家，从而加速资源受限设备上的MoE大语言模型推理。
en_tdlr: CECAR introduces a cache & expert co-aware routing system that uses ML-based prediction of expert reuse distance to prioritize routing toward experts with smaller reuse distances, accelerating on-device MoE LLM inference.
